objective: Preallocate EXPLAIN statistics and join-order formatting buffers.

tasks.title: Preallocate EXPLAIN formatting buffers
tasks.result: EXPLAIN now preallocates statistics column snippets, join relation schemas, and join-order labels from known bounded counts.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves EXPLAIN statistics text, join predicate membership checks, join-order labels, row estimates, and cost output.
